name: ElemCopy – Text Copy Button for Elementor
author: Pluginable

sections.description:
ElemCopy is a lightweight Elementor widget that allows users to copy any text to their clipboard with a single click. Whether it’s text, email address, links, or custom messages, ElemCopy makes it seamless and user-friendly.

Key Features:
– One-click copy functionality.
– Fully customizable button text and style.
– Compatible with all modern browsers.
– No extra plugins or coding required.

Pro Version Features:
– Copy Image to clipboard.
– Copy Code to clipboard.
– Dynamic Tags Enabled.
– Display full customizable toast notification after copy.

Support

For support, visit the Pluginable support page or contact us via our official support channels.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository or from the Pluginable.dev website.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  5. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  6. Once activated, you can start using ElemCopy immediately within Elementor. Simply edit any page with Elementor, search for “ElemCopy” in the widget panel, and drag the widget to your desired section. From there, customize the content and styling to fit your site’s design and functionality needs.
sections.faq:
What is the purpose of this plugin?

This plugin allows visitors to copy text, links, emails and code to the clipboard instantly with a single click, improving user experience and content accessibility.

Can the plugin copy real images to the clipboard?

Yes. The Pro version of the plugin supports copying both the actual image and the image HTML code, making it ideal for designers, developers and content creators.

Is any technical or coding knowledge required?

No. The plugin is beginner friendly and can be used without writing any code. All features are easy to configure.

Can I customize the look of the copy button?

Yes. You can personalize the button label, color, size, icon, alignment and overall style to match your website design.

Does this plugin work on all modern browsers?

Yes. It is fully compatible with major browsers and mobile devices, ensuring a smooth experience for all users.

Is it suitable for copying long URLs, coupon codes or affiliate links?

Yes. The plugin works perfectly with promo codes, long URLs, referral links, contact details and any other text based content.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. It is lightweight and optimized for performance, ensuring your site remains fast and responsive.

Can I display a notification after copying?

Yes. In Pro version of the plugin you can enable a toast notification or a success message to confirm that the content has been copied.

Does the plugin support dynamic tags?

Yes. In Pro version of the plugin Dynamic tags are supported, allowing you to copy dynamic values such as user data, custom fields or auto generated text.

Can I use this inside Elementor popups, sliders or containers?

Yes. Since this plugin works as an Elementor widget, it functions perfectly inside popups, sliders, containers, tabs, accordions and other advanced Elementor elements.
